policy.description: Aggressive tier for high-volume, lower-forensic-priority continuous stream sources (e.g. network flow/firewall telemetry): rollover at 5 GB or 7 days; delete after 90 days. Case-scoped evidence indices stay on kronos-rollover's longer retention -- this tier exists because continuous telemetry accumulates far faster and does not carry the same per-item evidentiary weight as case evidence, so a shorter, cost-conscious retention is the correct default rather than the case tier's 365-day window.
